title: WO configures ScrapeCreators as the primary social stats provider and preserves fallback behavior
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/ops-wo.test.mjs
S4: Read the named test results for ScrapeCreators settings, network-aware budgets, and provider chain behavior.
expect: The WO ops suite passes its ScrapeCreators settings test: key save encrypts/reads safely and test endpoint reports connected for a valid provider response.
The WO social stats suite passes its ScrapeCreators request budget test, covering Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok endpoint costs and partial TikTok coverage.

The source provider-chain suite passes its ScrapeCreators tests for supported networks, mapping provider data into the stable social stats shape and continuing through existing fallbacks on provider failure.
evidence: ScrapeCreators account and endpoint calls were also verified directly on 22/10/2026; response summaries are recorded in tasks/evidence/wo-scrapecreators-api-probe-2026-10-22.json without credentials.
fence: Deterministic tests verify the provider adapter, WO budget routing, and encrypted admin key settings. Not exercised by this regression case: live third-party calls or the full visual WO admin flow.
